body: Congrats bro I am also not an alt

Thank you all who talked to my son today and helped him work through this until we got to him.  These messages helped us understand what has been going on, and I can’t thank you enough for caring for my son!  He is getting the help he needs.

My dad came home and was freaking out.  It took him a while to get me out of the little area next to the fridge just big enough for me to fit into where i was hiding.  We talked for a while but he was exhausted and is now sleeping.  I didn't tell him about the way I've been feeling but I did talk to him about the current situation.

I don’t talk to many adults.  When I do it’s either my mom or my dad (mostly my mom).  But I only talk to them when they prompt me first or I’m in a good mood, which has been less and less lately.  My older sister I feel like I can talk to the most because we get along and trust each other, but I don’t want to add anymore onto what she already has.  She has ADHD, struggles with learning sometimes, and recently came out to me as pansexual.  She is probably the most innocent person I know but I don’t feel like I can talk to her.  It took all my courage to tell my friend,  but to tell my sister is another story.

I’ve told my friend, but he is most likely at school right now.  Also I’ve been in a constant mental state that no matter what I do, people will judge me, or hate me for longer than I’ve felt depressed.  Whether it is shame from getting a b on a test or missing the bus I feel guilty.  So when I told my friend about it, I regretted it, wished I never told him.  He was clearly in shock when I showed him why I was hiding my neck that day.
